def extract_year(value):
    """Return a 4-digit year from a cell value when possible."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.year
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value.year
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        iv = int(value)
        if 1000 <= iv <= 9999:
            return iv
        return None
    if isinstance(value, str):
        text = value.strip()
        # Try direct numeric year
        if text.isdigit():
            iv = int(text)
            if 1000 <= iv <= 9999:
                return iv
        # Try date parsing or any 4-digit year embedded in text
        match = re.search(r"\b(19|20)\d{2}\b", text)
        if match:
            return int(match.group(0))
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d"):
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).year
            except ValueError:
                pass
    return None

# Build mapping: shipped year -> unique project IDs
projects_by_year = {}

for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    project_id = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value  # Column B: Project ID
    shipped = ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value     # Column C: Shipped

    if project_id is None or shipped is None:
        continue

    year = extract_year(shipped)
    if year is None:
        continue

    projects_by_year.setdefault(year, set()).add(project_id)

for col in range(7, 12):  # G through K
    header_value = ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value
    year = extract_year(header_value)
    count = len(projects_by_year.get(year, set())) if year is not None else 0
    ws.cell(row=2, column=col).value = count
